question: Who won the Ranji trophy in 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vidarbha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vidarbha** won the **Ranji Trophy for the 2024-25 season**, continuing its legacy as one of the prominent teams in domestic cricket in India.
 
• The Ranji Trophy is India's premier first-class cricket championship, organized by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**. It was established in **1934**.
 
• Vidarbha's victory is a testament to its strong squad, excellent coaching staff, and strategic planning throughout the tournament.
 
• Vidarbha became a force to reckon with in Indian domestic cricket after winning consecutive Ranji Trophy titles in the **2017-18** and **2018-19** seasons.
 
• The team’s success is often attributed to their focus on nurturing young talent and balancing experience within the squad. Their players excel in both batting and bowling departments.
